[[File:Chandrila_JA.png|thumb|right|198px|[[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], an agriworld in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]]]
'''Agriworld''' was the term used to describe a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] whose entire industrial capacity was devoted completely to agriculture. Worlds within this category typically produced far more foodstuffs than what could possibly be necessary for its own population (including any immigrant workers); the surplus was then exported to many other worlds that were unable to sustain the food needs of their own population with their own resources. One such planet that benefited from the existence of agriworlds was [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the capital world of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] as well as other [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopoleis]], such as [[Denon/Legends|Denon]] and possibly [[Taris/Legends|Taris]].

[[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] was one such notable agriworld. The [[M'shinn]]i ruled several agriworlds within the [[M'shinni sector/Legends|M'shinni sector]], including [[Agriworld-2079/Legends|Agriworld-2079]], the home of the [[Skrilling/Legends|Skrilling]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Salliche Agricultural Corporation|Salliche Ag Corporation]] controlled eighteen agriworlds in [[Core Worlds/Legends|the Core]], including [[Salliche/Legends|Salliche]], [[Ruan]], [[Yulant]], and [[Broest/Legends|Broest]]. [[Orron III]] was an agriworld in the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]].
